final: WITH site_ratios AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(1.0 * m.facetresmm / m.geomdeltamm) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(m.facetregistry) AS mesh_count FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE m.facetresmm IS NOT NULL AND m.geomdeltamm IS NOT NULL AND m.geomdeltamm <> 0 GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), status_avgs AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS status_avg FROM site_ratios WHERE insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY insurstat), above AS (SELECT r.*, a.status_avg FROM site_ratios r JOIN status_avgs a ON a.insurstat = r.insurstat WHERE r.avg_ratio > a.status_avg) SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS above_sites_avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS site_count, AVG(avg_ratio - status_avg) AS avg_excess FROM above GROUP BY insurstat
